checks.name: Desktop and tablet reachability
checks.evidence: 1440×900, 1024×768 and 768×1024. All five navigation buttons, drafting buttons/select and assistant launcher meet 44×44 targets and hit tests. No drafting/top-toolbar overlap.

images.caption: Final build, 1024×768: original top settings, drafting actions, assistant launcher and restored bottom navigation are separately reachable.
Final build, 1024×768: lower scroll state exposes the phase controls while the top settings stay clear.
Final build, 768×1024: all five bottom navigation buttons remain visible and independent of the drafting panel.
Final build, 1440×900: complete model, drafting panel and separate bottom navigation.
Actual immediate PNG download: Solid Finish and Blueprint were invoked without yielding to an animation frame. The completed 2,180-part tower is visibly present.
Actual downloaded PDF, page 1: all 33 supplied Crown Wharf levels; model coordinates, no surveyed datum. Every page is illustrative, NTS and not for construction.
Actual downloaded PDF, page 2: lowest level triangle projection; triangulation is explicitly retained. Every page is illustrative, NTS and not for construction.
Actual downloaded PDF, page 3: upper level model projection; no invented core or partitions. Every page is illustrative, NTS and not for construction.
Actual downloaded PDF, page 4: X/Y elevation projection, explicitly not a cut section. Every page is illustrative, NTS and not for construction.
Actual downloaded PDF, page 5: actual current model snapshot. Every page is illustrative, NTS and not for construction.
Historical failure, build 4e6d1ebd3a62: preview lacked the separate bottom navigation. Preserved as before evidence, not accepted as the final result.
Historical development finding after restoring the bottom bar: the expanded drafting panel overlapped the lower edge of top settings. The final build dynamically reserves toolbar clearance.

limitations: This is a Windows production browser acceptance. Native package and macOS/Linux checks are separate.
The PDF contains illustrative raster model projections with triangulation and occluded lines, not clean section drawings or editable CAD.
The source fixture has 33 supplied levels. This does not claim a newly authored 52-storey multidisciplinary drawing package.
The tablet drafting panel scrolls internally to preserve top and bottom controls; it still covers part of the model while open.
retainedFindings: Previous build lacked preview bottom navigation. The final build uses the displayable model state.
The initial development fix exposed a tablet top-toolbar overlap. The final build reserves its measured height.
Earlier development attempts hit unavailable port 8080 and a stale browser channel. They did not establish application failures; isolated session recovery preceded passing checks.
downloadProvenance: The browser saved these exact run-specific filenames to C:/Users/danie/Downloads. Originals remain intact. Copies in this run downloads directory were verified byte-for-byte by SHA-256. Only anchor filenames were prefixed; original click and bytes were unchanged. The wrapper was restored.
